name: @sharedid-edge/module-reflect
description: SharedID Edge module: re-sets first-party cookies other scripts wrote (such as an ID vendor's uid1) as server-set cookies with a new lifetime

sharedidEdge.name: reflect
sharedidEdge.title: keep other first-party cookies durable
sharedidEdge.summary: Nothing in the payload: re-sets first-party cookies other scripts wrote (such as `uid1` or `_ga`) with the same value and a new expiry, so Safari doesn't cap them, and with `restore`, sets them again from an `HttpOnly` keeper cookie after Safari deletes them
